title: Measuring vibration on a packing shelf

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Before we wrap any of today's glass jars, I want to measure the vibration on the top shelf of the packing cart. Last week's readings were taken on the handle, which is convenient but doesn't tell us what the jars actually experience. For today's test, put the meter where the first jar would normally sit. Push the cart down the usual aisle at walking speed. If the numbers are lower, that won't prove the new shelf lining works. We need another run with the old lining and the meter in the same place.
turns.zh: 今天開始包裝玻璃罐前，我想先量包裝推車最上層的震動。上週是在把手上測的，雖然方便，卻不能說明罐子實際受到多大的震動。今天請把儀器放在平常放第一個罐子的位置。以步行速度推車走平常的走道。如果數值變低，也不能證明新襯墊有效。我們還得換回舊襯墊，並在相同位置裝好儀器，再跑一次測試。
